place.zh: 沉鼎观 · 药园 · 这一年
place.en: Chending Temple · The herb garden · That year

setup.zh: 一个月一篮残株，一炉一颗九转聚气丹。清明、端午、伏天、入秋——一季一层；白天，你照旧在讲堂上做漏勺。
setup.en: A basket of culls a month, a nine-turn qi pill a batch. Qingming, the Dragon Boat festival, the dog days, autumn — a layer a season; by day you are still the leaky ladle of the lecture hall.

recap.zh: 这一年，你一层一层往上走，人前却一天比一天笨；入秋，丹田那片湖满得往外漾——九层圆满。
recap.en: That year you climbed layer by layer, and in front of people grew clumsier by the day; in autumn the lake in your dantian brimmed over — the peak of layer nine.

en: A basket a month, a batch a basket.
In front of people, clumsier by the day.
Qingming, Dragon Boat, the dog days, autumn.

story.zh:
打那以后，周衡的残株一个月一篮，一篮进炉，出来的都是九转聚气丹，一个月一颗。

那几个月里，最难的倒不是修炼，是装。

一个人一天比一天耳聪目明，走起路来一天比一天轻，偏要在人前一天比一天笨，这比挑水劈柴还累。
story.en:
From then on Zhou Heng's culls came a basket a month, and every basket went into the furnace and came out a nine-turn qi pill — one a month.

In those months the hardest thing was not the cultivating. It was the pretending.

To hear sharper and see clearer by the day, to walk lighter by the day, and yet to be clumsier by the day in front of people — that was more tiring than carrying water and splitting wood.

exits.means: the spring month: burns paper for his grandfather and eats that month's pill

story.zh:
练气六层是在清明。

外公的坟在镇上，他去不了，便在后山寻了一块向着蒙山的石头，把那一沓黄纸点着了。

念到「五居中央」，纸烧完了，灰飞起来，打着旋儿往山下去，他丹田里那口水缸，水面又往上涨了一截。
story.en:
Qi Condensation layer six came at Qingming.

Grandfather's grave was in the town and he could not go, so he found a rock on the back hill facing Mengshan and set the stack of yellow paper alight.

As he reached "five in the middle", the paper burned out, the ash flew up and spun away down the mountain, and the water in the great jar of his dantian rose another notch.

exits.means: the early-summer month: the festival dumpling, the next layer

refuse.zh: 一季一季来：先过了前头那一季。
refuse.en: One season at a time: finish the one before first.

story.zh: 七层是在端午，伙房蒸了粽子，他那个里头有半颗枣，七层到的时候，一口枣核正卡在嗓子眼里。
story.en: Seven came at the Dragon Boat festival. The kitchen steamed zongzi, and his had half a date in it; when layer seven arrived, the stone was stuck in his throat.

label.en: The dog days · Cooling off on the low wall

exits.means: the hot month: nights on the herb-garden wall with A-He and Sun Ergou

refuse.zh: 一季一季来：先过了前头那一季。
refuse.en: One season at a time: finish the one before first.

story.zh:
八层是在伏天里，热得柴房里的耗子都搬了家。

伏天里最热的那几夜，药园巡完了，三个人常坐在药园的矮墙上乘凉：小满，阿禾，孙二狗。

小满问：「你想叫什么？」孙二狗想了半天，道：「……还叫二狗吧。我娘叫惯了。」

小满没笑。阿禾也没笑。墙底下的小狰翻了个身，打了个响鼻。
story.en:
Eight came in the dog days, so hot the rats moved out of the woodshed.

On the hottest nights of the dog days, when the garden round was done, the three of them would sit on the herb garden's low wall to cool off: Xiaoman, A-He, Sun Ergou.

Xiaoman asked: "What would you like to be called?" Sun Ergou thought for a long time and said: "…Ergou still. My mother's used to it."

Xiaoman did not laugh. Nor did A-He. Under the wall the little Zheng rolled over and snorted.

label.en: Autumn · The peak of layer nine

exits.means: the autumn month: the lake brims over, the peak of Qi Condensation; his master calls him up the cliff

refuse.zh: 一季一季来：先过了前头那一季。
refuse.en: One season at a time: finish the one before first.

story.zh:
到得入秋，丹田里那口水缸满得往外直漾，吸进去一口灵气，便溢出来一口，再也添不进去了——褚先生管这个，叫作「九层圆满」。

八月里，瞿老叫他上了一趟崖顶。
story.en:
By autumn the great jar in his dantian was brimming over: breathe in one breath of spirit and one spilled out; nothing more would go in — Master Chu called this "the peak of layer nine".

In the eighth month, Old Qu called him up to the clifftop.
